messages:
Ada (Growth): Idea - run a 25m 'Launchpad' mini-slate: 3 quick plays for production inference + one live micro-demo. Emphasis: quick wins for PMs + SREs. Need topic pick + abstracts + confirmed speaker list by EOD.

Priya (CMO): Love the positioning. Suggest we A/B subject lines: "Save 40% per inference" vs "Make inference predictable at scale". Target audience segments: product developers, infra leads, and procurement.

Noah (Producer): Format note: prefer single host + 2 short guest spots (3m each) then demo. Keeps transitions simple. Greenroom 30m before.

Maria (Content): Draft micro-abstracts:
- Play 1: "Batch smarter, not harder" - batching patterns + cost numbers (Maria + Leo)
- Play 2: "Private deploy checklist" - security controls + slide checklist (Priya + eng)
- Play 3: "Graceful fallbacks" - routing & canary + demo (Sam)
I'll write concise 2-line blurbs for landing.

Sam (Eng): For Play 3 demo, prefer simulated canary showing automatic fallback to a quantized low-cost model. Will prepare a recorded fallback run and a live small-query demo as backup.

Leo (Metrics): I can provide a 1-slide metric: tokens/s saved, p95 latency delta, and TCO delta—need sample workload by EOD. Maria, can you push a sample prompt set?

Ada (Growth): Good. On lead routing: primary CTA -> "Request Dedicated Eval" (enterprise), secondary -> "Run a 500-token bench with free credits" (self-serve). Noah, route high-intent signups to HubSpot owner tag: "dedicated-trial". Low friction leads go to product nurture.

Noah (Producer): Noted. I'll add form hidden fields: utm_campaign=launchpad_q2, intent=dedicated if they select enterprise CTA. I'll wire HubSpot mapping + Slack alert to #sales.

Priya (CMO): Speaker checklist: 1 slide max per play, 2 min talking points, 1 handoff sentence. Maria please prep speaker micro-briefs.

Maria (Content): Will do. Also creating two subject line variants + three social copy versions for LI/X. Drafts in Drive: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launchpad-mini-slate-drafts

Sam (Eng): Demo infra checklist (short):
```
- model primary: `redwood/opt-large:2026-03`
- fallback: `redwood/opt-quant-4bit`
- session ttl: 30s
- sampling: top_p=0.9, temp=0.2
- trace: enabled
```
I'll upload run commands to the rehearsal doc.

rehearsals-bot: Rehearsal booked: 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Join: https://meet.redwood/rehearsal-1789998888

Ada (Growth): Assignments & deadlines: Maria - landing + emails by EOD local; Leo - metric slide by EOD; Sam - demo recorded fallback + live backup by EOD; Noah - form + routing + run-of-show by EOD. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Maria (Content): :white_check_mark: first drafts uploaded.

Leo (Metrics): :white_check_mark: sample metric slide in drive.

Sam (Eng): :white_check_mark: fallback record uploaded; will run live test 8:30 PT the day of.

Noah (Producer): :white_check_mark: HubSpot mapping set, run-of-show draft posted to drive.

Ada (Growth): Quick note on promos: schedule emails 3 days + 1 day + 1 hour before. Social posts staggered across timezones. Priya, any partner amplification asks?

Priya (CMO): I'll loop in partner channels and ask for one co-post from our Dedicated customer. Also prepare a short press blurb for partners.

Ada (Growth): Great. If we get signups > threshold (50) within 24h, we'll escalate to sales SDR follow-up. Thresholds and routing in the runbook.

Noah (Producer): Final run-of-show draft (in minutes): 00:00 host intro (Ada) — 02:00 play 1 (Maria) — 07:00 customer vignette (Priya guest) — 10:00 play 2 (Priya) — 15:00 play 3 routing + demo (Sam recorded + live backup) — 22:00 live Qs (chat) — 25:00 CTA & close.

Ada (Growth): Thanks all. Locking this plan. Tag me for any blockers.
